title: LRU cache
skill: Say what counts as a use

good: Fix the LRUCache class in src/lru.js so it is a real least-recently-used cache. Rules: 1) the constructor throws RangeError unless capacity is an integer >= 1 (0, -1, 1.5, NaN, "3", undefined all throw); 2) get(key) returns the value or undefined, and a hit makes the key most recently used; 3) set(key, value) adds or updates, and both make the key most recently used (delete then re-add in the Map); 4) updating an existing key never evicts; 5) adding a new key to a full cache first evicts the least recently used key; 6) set() returns this, so calls chain; 7) has(key) returns a boolean and does not change recency; 8) add a size getter. Do not change other files. Then run: node --test test/*.test.js
lazy: Fix the LRU cache, it evicts the wrong entries.
